_about: DRAFT, not in the game. The achievements proposed on 18 Nov 2026. 'tier' is the rarity it is about (0 COMMON ... 6 SINGULARITY); 'goal' is how many different gems the cabinet must hold ('all' = every gem there is when it is earned). The numbers are suggestions: change them here, the review page and the README follow.

groups.title: Rarity firsts
groups.note: The first time an answer of that rarity scores. Seven of them, one per rarity.

groups.title: The gem ladder
groups.note: How many DIFFERENT gems the cabinet holds (a gem found again does not count twice). Roughly 2x to 2.5x more work for each step.

achievements.name: Singularity Complete
achievements.text: Find every gem in the game.
